question: Why does the fivefold nature appear clearly in each emanation from will-power?
premises: Each emanation is necessarily of the nature of the five powers.
This is clear in every single case.
It arises from will-power abiding in its own single form.
inference: The fivefold structure becomes clear in each emanation because will-power expresses its one nature as five powers.
plain_english: Because it is necessarily of the nature of the five powers, this is clear in each case, as the power of will, abiding in its own nature, appears from a single form.
